purpose: Define the one bounded, final both-class validation gate that is minimally required before an existing ROLE_L_FULL_TASK candidate can be selected for a later M-PV4 gate.

present_requirement.rule: Include the existing 57 eligible D1 PRESENT contexts; do not regenerate labels or replace contexts after lock.

absent_requirement.rule: Lock exactly 57 eligible D1 ABSENT contexts, 19 from each held-out subject, before any M-PV3.8 candidate output is inspected.

one_time_final_validation_membership.subject_rule: Every included subject must contribute both eligible PRESENT and eligible ABSENT contexts. No subject, recording, or window may be in candidate training and this final membership.
one_time_final_validation_membership.lock_rule: The complete membership manifest, hashes, class counts, and subject counts are frozen before any of the six candidate outputs are opened. No top-up, replacement, resampling, or second final membership is permitted.

evaluation_protocol.absent_metric_interpretation: ABSENT recall, specificity, precision, and F1 are mandatory both-class reporting evidence. They receive no new numerical selection threshold in M-PV3.8 and cannot compensate for a frozen guard failure.

selection_decision.candidate_pass_condition: The candidate passes every Class A safety requirement and every frozen breathing and RR guard on D1_FINAL_SELECTION_BOTH_CLASS_V1.
selection_decision.selection_ready_condition: Exactly one of the six authorized candidates satisfies the candidate pass condition.
selection_decision.multiple_pass_condition: Two or more candidates satisfy the candidate pass condition. Emit MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES_PASS_NO_SELECTION; do not rank, break ties, or select a seed.
selection_decision.no_pass_condition: No candidate satisfies the candidate pass condition. Emit NO_SELECTION_READY.
selection_decision.membership_failure_condition: If the locked membership violates class, subject, provenance, or AMBIGUOUS rules, emit BLOCKED_INVALID_FINAL_MEMBERSHIP without evaluating selection.
selection_decision.m_pv4_authorization: Only SINGLE_SELECTION_READY authorizes a later, separately governed M-PV4 gate. It does not authorize deployment, threshold change, D2 access, or MR60 supervised physiology.

bounded_rr_remediation.scope: One pre-registered RR-only remediation hypothesis, applied once to the fixed Family B/C and seed 11/23/47 roster using immutable split and provenance rules. The remediation may not alter breathing, safety, labels, thresholds, D2 access, MR60 supervised physiology, or the final membership definition.
bounded_rr_remediation.evaluation_rule: Train or fit only from authorized non-final training data if the future remediation protocol requires it, then perform one final evaluation on the already locked membership. No interim inspection, rerun, top-up, second remediation, or repeated final evaluation is permitted.
bounded_rr_remediation.after_unsuccessful_remediation: NO_SELECTION_READY is terminal for this candidate direction; M-PV4 remains unauthorized and no additional data-collection or RR-remediation loop is authorized by M-PV3.8.

stopping_condition: Stop immediately after the one-time final membership is invalidated or after its single evaluation produces a terminal decision. If and only if the RR-only trigger is met, stop after M-PV3.8-RR-ONE produces its one terminal decision.
